_comment: Canonical invoke payloads for the session-record commands (spec §36) and
for the stage snapshot they make possible (§43.5, §46.6). Read by BOTH
sides so the DTOs cannot drift apart:
types deserialize exactly these payloads, and publishes the snapshot
C1 — the shape that mattered. `start_session` has NO sessionGeneration
field: the generation is an OUTPUT of AppCoordinator::begin_session,
returned on the record, and control adopts it. When control invented its
own (a hard-coded 1) while nothing ever called this command, the
coordinator stayed at 0 and every snapshot below was silently dropped.
_publish_stage_snapshot_comment: The envelope control relays ~15 times a second. `sessionGeneration` and
`stageGeneration` are placeholders here: both tests overwrite them with
the live coordinator values, because the whole point is that the numbers
must come from the coordinator rather than from a constant.
